card.name: Maryland addresses and ZIP codes
card.fires_on: Punctuation, place-name parts and ZIP digits in Maryland addresses, such as after Bethesda or Rockville, before MD and a 208xx ZIP code. It also fires after Maryland-area names in other text.

modes.label: Comma or space after town
modes.description: The comma or space right after Bethesda or Rockville where MD or a phone number is expected next.
modes.example: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders National Institutes of Health 31 Center Drive, MSC 2320 Bethesda<<,>> MD 20892-

modes.label: ZIP code start
modes.description: The first digit of a Maryland ZIP code after MD or Maryland.
modes.example: 1212 or MEDWATCH, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), 5600 Fishers Lane, Rockville, MD <<2>>0852-978

modes.label: Inside Rockville or before Maryland
modes.description: The ending of Rockville or a small word just before the state name Maryland.
modes.example: 855-1212 or MEDWATCH, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), 5600 Fishers Lane, Rock<<ville>>, MD 20852

card.writes: It pushes the word Maryland and suppresses other state names like Virginia and VA.
card.plain: It marks spots in a mailing address where the state is Maryland, such as Bethesda or Rockville, MD.
